jobs.prompt: Fix two HIGH findings from the Opus re-review in tools/gate-rerun.mjs (existing module, not wired) and extend tests/gate-rerun.test.mjs. (1) Real node:test TAP output writes the location line as  location: '/abs/path/x.test.mjs:2:1'  with quotes and an absolute path; the parser keeps the leading quote so the path safety check passes on a bogus path and the rerun fails. Fix: strip surrounding quotes, remove the :line:col suffix, if absolute take path.relative(cwd, abs) and accept only a non-'..' relative result that looks like a test file, else drop it. Add a test using a verbatim realistic TAP block (with the quoted absolute location inside cwd and one outside cwd). (2) TAP escapes '#' in test names ('not ok 1 - a \# b') and the name is kept escaped, so the --test-name-pattern matches nothing, node runs zero tests and exits 0 and rerunFailed returns ok true: a FALSE GREEN. Fix: unescape TAP names ('\#' to '#', '\\' to '\'), and make rerunFailed verify the rerun really ran the targeted tests: for node-test parse the rerun output for the '# tests' count (must be greater than 0) and that every targeted name appears as an 'ok' or 'not ok' line; for pytest require the summary line to show at least one passed or failed; otherwise return ok false with a reason string 'rerun ran no matching tests'. Add tests for the escaped # name and for a zero-tests rerun being reported ok false. Do not touch redaction or argv filtering in this job. IMPORTANT: the repository's secret scanner blocks test files with literal secret-looking assignments: in tests build fake secret values at run time (concatenation or repeat) and use neutral variable names. Keep every other existing test passing.
